issues.display_title: Issue #62: Fix Issue Plain Click Does Not Deselect Previously Selected Image (Sticky Selection)
issues.main_description_html:
Source

User feedback

Problem

In the file grid, a plain click (no modifier) on a second image does not clear the previous selection — the first image stays selected. Expected behavior is that a plain click selects only the clicked item and deselects everything else.

Expected selection behavior (standard file-manager semantics)

  • Plain click → select only that item; deselect all others (single selection).
  • Ctrl/Cmd + click → toggle that item's selection (add/remove) without clearing others.
  • Shift + click → select the contiguous range from the last-selected item to the clicked item.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. A plain click on an image selects only that image and clears any previous selection.
  2. Ctrl/Cmd + click adds/removes an image from the current multi-selection.
  3. Shift + click selects a contiguous range.
  4. Selection state stays consistent and predictable across clicks (no stuck/"sticky" selections).

issues.display_title: Issue #61: Preview: Allow Zoom (And Pan) on Flat Images Mode
issues.main_description_html:
Source

User feedback

Problem

In Preview, the Flat view mode does not allow zooming into the image. Users need to zoom in to inspect detail on flat (non-360-projected) images.

Request

Enable zoom on Flat images in the Preview viewer (zoom in/out + pan), the same way users expect to inspect image detail.

Scope

  • Add zoom (and pan while zoomed) to the Flat view mode in Preview.
  • Support common zoom interactions: scroll/pinch to zoom, and drag to pan when zoomed in.
  • Keep existing Preview controls (view-mode toggles, navigation) working.
  • Confirm interaction does not conflict with the pan/hand tool already present.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Users can zoom into a Flat image in Preview (in and out).
  2. While zoomed, users can pan around the image.
  3. Zoom is smooth and does not break other Preview controls or view modes.

issues.display_title: Issue #57: Watermark Output With Dense GoThru Logo For Non-Subscribers
issues.main_description_html:
Source

User feedback:

Goal

Instead of blocking non-subscribed users from features, open the features to everyone but watermark the output with a dense GoThru logo for non-subscribers (PtGui-style).

Scope

  • Apply a dense/tiled GoThru logo watermark to output (stitching output first; confirm whether it applies to other feature outputs too).
  • Gate watermark on subscription state: non-subscribers get watermarked output; paid/Pro users get clean, watermark-free output.
  • Match the PtGui approach (dense tiled overlay, not a single corner mark).

Open questions

  • Which outputs/features does the watermark apply to (stitching only, or all Pro features)?
  • Watermark density/opacity/branding spec.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Non-subscribed users can use the feature(s), but output is watermarked with a dense GoThru logo.
  2. Paid/Pro users receive clean, un-watermarked output.
  3. Watermark visibility is driven by subscription state.

issues.display_title: Issue #56: [Epic] Integrate GoThru-PtGui Stitching App Into Main Rust App
issues.main_description_html:
Source

User feedback

Goal

Integrate the standalone GoThru-PtGui stitching Rust app (built with Fable 5, currently usable/beta) into the main Photo Studio Rust app.
https://github.com/GoThruMedia/GoThru-PtGui

Key consideration

The author will keep updating the standalone GoThru-PtGui repo. Integration must account for ongoing upstream changes — decide the integration strategy:

  • Vendor as a git submodule / path dependency, or
  • Publish GoThru-PtGui as a Rust crate the main app depends on, or
  • Merge the source and sync periodically.

Pick an approach that lets the standalone code keep evolving without forking divergence.

Scope

  • Evaluate GoThru-PtGui structure and how it exposes stitching (CLI/lib/binary).
  • Define the integration boundary (Tauri command / sidecar / linked crate).
  • Wire stitching into the app's Edit/Stitching flow.
  • Document the update/sync process so upstream changes flow in.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Stitching from GoThru-PtGui is invocable inside the main Photo Studio app.
  2. A documented, low-friction path exists to pull in upstream GoThru-PtGui updates.
  3. Stitching runs end-to-end on real 360 input within the app.

Related: watermarking for non-subscribers, free-during-beta, and lens-DB expansion are tracked as separate issues.

Goal

Expand the lens database used by the stitching app beyond the current 2 lenses.

Current state

Scope

  • Add more lens profiles to the stitching database (author is supplying additional lens data).

Acceptance Criteria

  2. Users can select from the expanded lens list during stitching.

issues.display_title: Issue #64: fix: custom title bar hidden behind fullscreen modals/login overlay
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by Developer

Upload

Login

Problem

The custom (Tauri, draggable) title bar renders below fullscreen overlays — the login screen and the three fullscreen upload modals (GoThru, Panorra, StreetView) cover it, so the window can't be dragged/controlled while those are open.

Fix (implemented, in working tree, not yet committed)

  • src/renderer/components/layouts/Header/TitleBar.tsx — raise the title bar to z-[10000] so it always sits above overlays.
  • src/renderer/components/core/Login.tsx — anchor the login overlay to start below the title bar (top: var(--menubar-h, 0px)) instead of inset-0, so the title bar stays interactive during login.
  • src/renderer/components/features/Upload/{GoThru,Panorra,StreetView}/*.tsx — fullscreen variant of each upload modal now applies titlebar-safe-modal-wrapper / titlebar-safe-modal-backdrop classes and sets isDismissable/isKeyboardDismissDisabled based on login state.
  • src/renderer/index.css — new rules .titlebar-safe-modal-wrapper (offsets wrapper below the title bar) and .titlebar-safe-modal-backdrop (pointer-events: none so backdrop doesn't block title bar clicks).
  • Test: src/renderer/components/layouts/Header/titlebarLayer.test.mjs (3 assertions, passing).

Status

Implementation complete, node --experimental-strip-types --test titlebarLayer.test.mjs passes. Awaiting review/commit.
